chunk-001:c003.proposition: Laboratory research has begun to reveal reproducible processes by which simple chemistry generates complexity capable of initiating evolution, without purporting to reproduce Earth's exact molecular history.

chunk-001:c005.proposition: Meteorites, geology, and cosmology support an initially simpler chemical environment, while leaving the exact sequence of molecules leading to life unresolved.

chunk-001:c007.proposition: The geological record supports the relatively rapid appearance of simple cellular life after early bombardment, although it does not disclose the mechanism connecting simple chemistry to life.

chunk-001:c008.proposition: Encoded information indicates agency, making the experimentally investigable transition from simple chemistry to information-using, decision-making chemical systems a central step toward life.

chunk-002:c002-02.proposition: The molybdate experiment exhibits molecular templating and a coupled autocatalytic set in which templates enable otherwise inaccessible structures, providing an elementary information-bearing analogue to replication.

chunk-002:c002-03.proposition: Origin-of-life progress can be pursued through explicit assumptions and falsifiable complexity tests without claiming to reconstruct the unique historical sequence by which terrestrial life arose.

chunk-002:c002-07.proposition: A bottom-up search for a general life-producing phenomenon is a legitimate account of scientific progress when indications of emergent complexity are kept distinct from proof that life has been produced.

chunk-002:c002-08.proposition: Naturally available molybdate chemistry can spontaneously form information-bearing templates and coupled catalytic sets that produce otherwise inaccessible structures and further causal activity.

chunk-002:c002-10.proposition: Permissive laboratory environments may support the emergence of a primitive cell whose changing polymer sequences generate functions that improve persistence and establish an observable lineage.

chunk-003:chunk003-candidate-04.proposition: An objective measure of molecular complexity supplies the beginnings of a testable theory in which chemical evolution is a general phenomenon extending beyond existing biology.

chunk-003:chunk003-candidate-05.proposition: A calculable theory offers an experimentally testable route to a primitive ribosome, addressing a crucial information barrier in the machinery that translates genetic material into cellular components.

chunk-003:chunk003-candidate-06.proposition: Origin-of-life inquiry can proceed through an explicit theory–experiment cycle in which objective evidence may falsify the proposed mechanism and guide iterative revision under acknowledged uncertainty.
